title: Service Delivery Manager
description:
About the Role

The Service Delivery Manager (SDM) – Cloud Management & Operations Platform is responsible for overseeing the end-to-end operational support, customer satisfaction, and service reliability for an enterprise multi-tenant cloud management platform. In this leadership role, you manage a tiered operational organization comprising L1 (Incident Monitoring & Triage), L2 (Platform & Agentic Operations), and L3 (SRE & Core Platform Escalations) teams. You will act as the primary operational liaison between external enterprise customers and internal engineering organizations. You will own Service Level Agreements (SLAs/SLOs), drive major incident governance, lead post-incident reviews (RCAs), optimize support workflows, and spearhead continuous operational improvements to minimize customer downtime and maximize adoption of the cloud management platform.

Responsibilities

* Tiered Team Leadership & Resource Management: Direct, mentor, and allocate resources across 24/7/365 L1, L2, and L3 support teams. Define shift coverage, on-call rotations, escalation matrices, and technical career progression pathways for support engineers.
* SLA/SLO Ownership & Service Governance: Accountable for meeting contractual Service Level Agreements (MTTA, MTTR, availability targets) across all customer accounts. Maintain live service health dashboards and deliver periodic operational reviews (QBRs/MBRs) to customer leadership.
* Major Incident Management (MIM): Act as the executive incident commander during Critical/P1 outages impacting customer cloud environments or platform availability. Direct the cross-functional resolution bridge, manage external crisis communications, and eliminate operational bottlenecks.
* Problem Management & RCA Delivery: Partner with L3 engineers, SREs, and product engineering to lead Root Cause Analyses (RCAs) following outages. Track post-incident corrective and preventative action items (CAPAs) to ensure systemic platform vulnerabilities are resolved.
* Operational Shift-Left & Automation: Drive "shift-left" operational strategies—empowering L1 teams to resolve recurring issues through automated runbooks developed by L2/L3 engineers, thereby reducing MTTR and tier-escalation volume.
* Customer Relationship & Escalation Handling: Serve as the designated operational escalation contact for enterprise customer stakeholders. Manage client friction, track recurring customer pain points, and translate operational findings into feature requests for the product roadmap.
* Vendor & Tooling Operations: Oversee support tools and platforms, including ITSM systems (ServiceNow, Jira Service Management), paging systems (PagerDuty, Opsgenie), and client-facing status portals.

Requirements

* Experience: 7–12 years in IT service management, technical support leadership, or cloud infrastructure operations, with at least 3+ years directly managing multi-tiered technical teams (L1/L2/L3) in a B2B SaaS, Managed Service Provider (MSP), or Cloud Platform setting.
* ITSM & Framework Expertise: Deep practical knowledge of ITIL processes (Incident, Problem, Change, and Release Management), with demonstrated experience tailoring frameworks to agile cloud environments.
* Cloud & Platform Technical Acumen: Broad understanding of cloud infrastructure concepts (AWS, Azure, or GCP), container platforms (Kubernetes, Docker), and cloud operational paradigms (monitoring, log ingestion, and API-based integrations).
* Incident & Crisis Leadership: Proven track record acting as Incident Commander or escalation manager during complex, high-impact enterprise production outages.
* Metrics & Analytics Driven: Strong ability to track, analyze, and present operational KPIs (Ticket Volume, First-Contact Resolution, SLA Breaches, MTTA/MTTR trends, CSAT) using reporting tools (Power BI, Tableau, Jira dashboards).
* Communication & Executive Presence: Exceptional communication skills with the ability to articulate technical failures and remediation steps clearly to C-level client executives and non-technical stakeholders.

Nice to Have

* Certifications: ITIL v4 Foundation / Managing Professional, PMP (Project Management Professional), or Certified Scrum Master (CSM).
* Cloud Certifications: Foundational cloud certifications (e.g., AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner / Solutions Architect Associate, Azure Fundamentals AZ-900).
* DevOps & SRE Alignment: Experience transitioning traditional ITSM support structures toward modern Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) practices and error budget management.
* Tooling Proficiency: Deep administrative experience configuring workflows, SLAs, and routing rules inside ServiceNow, Jira Service Management, or Zendesk.
* FinOps/Contract Knowledge: Exposure to cloud economics, consumption models, and managing operational support profitability (P&L tracking, statement of work commitments).

Pay: ₹1,079,000.00 - ₹2,230,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Health insurance
* Life insurance
* Provident Fund

Application Question(s):

* Do you have experience with AWS, Azure, or GCP?
* Do you have Experience in SLA/SLO Management & Operational KPI Reporting

Experience:

* IT service management: 8 years (Required)

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu

title: Supervisor III, Applications Development
description:
**The** **Opportunity:**
------------------------

Oversees day-to-day operational objectives through the supervision of a team of application development engineers, ensuring efficient software build, release, deployment, and configuration management. Sets objectives that directly impact operational plans, contributing to the implementation of new applications, deployment frameworks, automation processes, and software quality standards. Evaluates and refines work methods, recommending enhancements to improve software implementation effectiveness, deployment efficiency, and system stability. Works on technical challenges that require data analysis, troubleshooting, and strategic consideration of infrastructure dependencies. Communicates regularly with internal teams, including QA, IT, and cloud operations, to align release strategies with organizational priorities. Engages external partners, vendors, and stakeholders to ensure smooth coordination in deployment efforts and software updates.  
  

About the Role

We are converting this position from contract to full-time. Sanjay built the automation layer that now vets every release. We need someone who owns the quality strategy, manages a small team of test engineers, and keeps our AI-driven test infrastructure running as product demands grow.

You will report to the Senior QA Manager, Development team. You will work with product, platform, and DevOps teams. You decide what "good enough to ship" means for our applications; you build the systems that prove it.

  
  

What You'll Own



Automation architecture. Design and maintain test frameworks on the Appvance AI Quality Platform. You decide how tests get structured, how data flows through them, and where they plug into our release pipeline.

* Team management. Directly manage 2–4 test automation engineers. Set their weekly priorities. Review their pull requests. Run 1:1s. Write their annual performance reviews. You decide who takes which feature area. You decide whether their work meets our standards before it merges.

* AI application testing. Build test suites that validate LLM-based features. Test prompt regression. Verify RAG workflows. Detect hallucinations. Validate agent behavior. Use LangChain and LangSmith.

* Scripting and tooling.Write and review Appvance Designer Scripts. Write JavaScript/TypeScript code. Build API test suites for REST and GraphQL. You set the coding standards others follow.

* CI/CD integration.Wire tests into GitHub Actions, Jenkins, and AWS deployments. When a build fails, your tests tell us why within minutes.

* Cross-platform coverage. Ensure web, mobile, desktop, and API layers each have appropriate automated coverage. Cover functional, regression, smoke, integration, end-to-end, security, performance, and database scenarios.

* Quality metrics.Track failure rates, flakiness, coverage gaps, and release-blocking defects. Present these to leadership in plain language.

* Hiring and growth.Interview candidates for automation roles. Write growth plans for your reports. Push them toward harder problems. Do not let them stay comfortable.

* Incident support. Join production release calls. Respond to critical incidents when automation uncovers—or misses—something that hits customers.

  
  

What You've Done Before

* 2–3 years hands-on with the Appvance AI Quality Platform, including Appvance Designer Scripting.

* You write clean JavaScript ES6+ and TypeScript. You read production-grade code and you write it.

* You tested AI-powered applications with LangChain and LangSmith. You validated prompts. You checked response accuracy. You verified RAG pipelines.

* You built or maintained test frameworks for UI, API, database, and cross-browser scenarios.

* You integrated test suites into Git, GitHub, Jenkins, GitHub Actions, AWS, and CI/CD workflows.

* You worked with SQL (MySQL, PostgreSQL, SQL Server) and NoSQL (MongoDB) data stores.

* You know REST APIs, GraphQL, JSON/XML, OAuth 2.0, JWT.

* You worked in Agile/Scrum. You know SDLC, STLC, and defect lifecycle.

* You managed or mentored at least one other engineer, even informally.

* Bachelor's or master's in CS, IT, or equivalent.

  
  

How You Work

  
  

* You debug like a detective. When a test fails, you do not re-run it and hope. You trace the failure to its source.

* You write code others can read. Your scripts have clear structure. You comment where needed. Your naming stays consistent.

* You communicate across roles. You explain a flaky test to a product manager. You explain a coverage gap to a director.

* You care about shipping speed. You know the difference between a test that catches real bugs and a test that slows releases but adds no value.

* You give direct feedback. Your reports know where they stand because you tell them.

  
  

Work Environment

  
  

* Hybrid, following our Coimbatore office policy.

* Primarily computer-based work.

* Availability for production releases and critical incidents as needed.

title: Project Coordinator
description:

The ideal candidate should bring energy, ownership, and leadership to drive results across multiple initiatives.

* **Strategic Execution:** Translate business objectives into actionable project plans and ensure alignment with company goals.
* **Stakeholder Communication:** Act as a key point of contact for internal and external stakeholders, ensuring clear communication and updates.
* **Risk & Resource Management:** Identify potential risks, allocate resources efficiently, and manage dependencies proactively.
* **Process Improvement:** Recommend best practices to enhance efficiency, quality, and delivery outcomes.

**Required Qualifications:**

* **MBA (Master of Business Administration)** — Mandatory.
* **Excellent communication**, leadership, and analytical skills.
* Strong understanding of project management methodologies (Agile, Scrum, or PMP preferred).
* Proficiency in tools like Jira, Asana, Trello, or MS Project.

**Preferred Skills:**

* Strong organizational, documentation, and multitasking abilities.
* Ability to collaborate effectively and manage priorities in a dynamic environment.
